summary: English and Spanish first-party discovery identified the official Alcaldía del Municipio Miranda portal, its linked SIGAT municipal tax platform, and the national IGVSB cartographic/mapoteca site. The accessible municipal pages expose no cadastral viewer or parcel API; IGVSB exposes general maps and a POST-only general map catalog. No anonymous safe parcel ID-plus-geometry response was qualified and no sample was retained.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All discovery queries, URLs, direct requests, response outcomes, configuration inspection, schema/CRS checks, safe field allowlist, scope limits, and uncertainty are recorded in city-2453-coro.json. No login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, credentials, private tokens, TLS bypass, or unsafe-field request occurred.
